title: input-runner-host-map-v1
description: Committed runner-host inventory consumed by the host-route runs-on evaluator (tsp-ihne1.56.5 design section 4). The authoritative map is generated in pocketforge-automation from committed provisioning facts and vendored here with a .SOURCE pin.

generated_from.description: Provenance of the generation inputs in pocketforge-automation.

runner.description: Stable runner/host id; unique across entries.

name_pattern.description: fnmatch pattern for runner instance names (e.g. mm-eph-build*).

labels.description: Complete label set carried by the runner (GitHub subset matching: job labels must be a subset).

label_patterns.description: Alternative to labels: every job label must fnmatch one pattern.

physical_host.description: Physical machine hosting the runner, when known.

host_class.description: vm = virtualised guest on company hardware; bare-metal = the physical host itself.

ephemeral.description: Runner is torn down after each job.

seat_policy.description: forbidden = no login seat may exist (headless provisioning); present = a live desktop seat exists; unknown = untrusted/uncorroborated (GitHub-hosted). A map with seat_policy=unknown for a self-hosted class fails generation.

provisioning_sources.description: Committed provisioning files corroborating this entry (repo-relative paths).

may_launch_pfvd_guest.description: Whether this host may launch a pfvd guest (guard domain a).
